title: Political Influence, Bank Capital, and Credit Allocation
near_miss_reason: Staggered setting (314 gubernatorial elections across states, 1990-2012; treatment After x Democratic winner) but the DiD is stacked-only: state_main.dta is a bank x election-window panel [-3, +3] around each election in which 72% of bank-years appear in more than one election window (banks enter up to 12 windows), estimated with bank FE, election (state x election-date) FE and calendar-year FE. Every DiD column (Tables 2-8 Panel A) also includes the 'After' indicator for all banks (event-time main effect, an extra regressor) and time-varying controls (ROA, ROA growth, log assets, state GDP, GDP growth, unemployment, or lagged loan/bank variables). Stock-sale columns are ordered logits.
eligible_reason: Stacked-only election-window design with an additional After regressor and time-varying controls in every DiD column; the remaining evidence is RD on vote margins and ordered logits. No column satisfies the design rules.
design_notes: state_main.do: xtreg y after int_after_dom $controls i.election_fe i.cyear if year!=0, fe i(rssd9001) cluster(rssd9001); int_after_dom = (year>0) x (winner_g=='D'); election_fe = rssd9210*electiondate_g. Table 2 Panel A col 1 (book equity): After x Democratic = -0.046 (t = -2.005), N = 230,256. Tables 2-6 Panel B are RD (vote margin <= 0.2, polynomials) on post-election years. Table 7 (federal charter switching) and Table 8 (federally chartered banks) use the same stacked specification.
data_files_note: Call Report, election, CRA, FDIC branch and HMDA variables merged at the bank-election-year level.
screener_notes: Published PDF text checked (Tables 2-8; election FE described as in the text). Regression inventory file was empty although the do-files contain xtreg/reg/ologit commands.
